dataclass Delivery
  digest: str
  media_type: str
  size: int
  location: str
dataclass Document
  request: Request | None
  result: JobResult | None
const EXECUTION_GUARANTEES
dataclass ImageRequest
  model: str
  mode: Mode | None
  prompt: str
  size: str
  count: int
  image_digest: str
  image_media_type: str
  mask_digest: str
  mask_media_type: str
  guarantees: list[RequestGuarantee | str]
  credential: str
  required_extensions: list[str]
  extensions: dict[str, str]
dataclass JobResult
  profile: Profile | None
  deliveries: list[Delivery]
  host: str
  model: str
const KINDS
enum Mode
  GENERATE = 'generate'
  EDIT = 'edit'
enum Profile
  VIDEO = 'video'
  IMAGE_BATCH = 'image_batch'
class Refusal(ValueError)
  __init__(word, offset)
dataclass Request
  profile: Profile | None
  image: ImageRequest
  duration_ms: int
enum RequestGuarantee
  LOCAL_ONLY = 'abstraction.inference/local-only@1'
  HOSTED_ALLOWED = 'abstraction.inference/hosted-allowed@1'
def decode(data)
def encode(v)
